IncidentDef.label: stranger in black
IncidentDef.letterText: Sensing trouble, a [PAWN_kind] has come down the road. The stranger won't give a name or say who sent [PAWN_objective], only that someone in the Imperial City would rather your colony didn't fall. Under the cloak is the dragon crest of the Blades.\n\nThe Emperor of Anvil has already sent a letter taking credit.
